summary: Episode 25: On a clear night Tariq marveled at how faithfully the stars and seasons return. Salim told him how Muslim astronomers once measured the heavens so precisely their work guided scholars for centuries, and that such order is a sign of the One who set it turning. Tariq came to see his love of the night sky as a quiet form of worship. Noor still doesn't know who leaves the gifts at her door.
open_threads: Noor still doesn't know who leaves the anonymous gifts at her door (Tariq knows it is Salim)
Tariq now sees observing creation as a form of worship
The reading circle continues to grow
The traveler is gone, carrying the district's kindness into the world
